title: Kilmar Ábrego García, man at center of Trump deportation battle, leaves US
summary_full: Salvadorian man, who was deported in March 2025 and returned to US after supreme court ruling, leaving of own volition for SpainKilmar Ábrego García has left the United States of his own volition, his lawyers confirmed on Tuesday, with the Department of Homeland Security confirming that he was travelling to Spain.A source close to Ábrego said Madrid was his first stop but that it would not be his final destination.
